name: 컬러팅! 캐치&라비 (Colorting! Catch&Rabi)
description:
About This Game

“Coloring! Catch & Rabi” is a 3D TPS two-player co-op shooter-platformer. Players split melee and ranged roles or work together toward shared goals. Play as doodle-born fairies, collect Keys to find Mag, defeat Mag, and restore the stolen colors.
short_desc: Divide roles with melee and ranged characters, tackle mechanics alongside Catch & Rabi, and work together toward a single goal to overcome the challenges ahead!
